acceptance_predicates.description: Each invocation receives a cryptographically random local client key with at least 256 bits of entropy and no reuse.
The exact pinned sidecar binds only to a validated kernel-selected loopback endpoint and is runtime-owned.
Keys and OAuth material never enter argv, observable logs, reports, manifests, environment dumps, or coordinator state.
Every success and failure path terminates and reaps the sidecar group and removes private staging.

definition_of_done: Hostile lifecycle, listener, substitution, permission, cancellation, and redaction tests pass.
Independent review, exact-head CI, merge, and post-merge CI are green.

outputs.description: Runtime-owned endpoint and opaque ephemeral-key handle.

gates.description: Sidecar startup, readiness, use, cancellation, and cleanup remain bounded.
Secret scanners and adversarial output tests find no credential disclosure.
